fields.title: Poisson ratio and isotropy
fields.finding: Primary nu=0.0768 is the historical SR-200 in-plane value represented as an isotropic scalar. Legacy nu=.33 changes the R10 scarf-screen endpoint from a deficit to a small surplus. The sign is convention-sensitive.
fields.next_evidence: Use a complete current orthotropic material matrix and shell analysis; establish the relevant orientation and post-form properties.
fields.check_disposition: Retained physical/model limitation. Arithmetic reproduction does not establish an installed-hull allowable.
